Rules_Summary: Maximum allowed per night for hotel accommodation in Tier 1 cities. Original receipt mandatory.
Covers breakfast ($15), lunch ($25), and dinner ($35). No itemized meal receipts required under $75.
Economy class mandatory for domestic flights under 6 hours. Business class allowed for flights exceeding 8 hours with SVP approval.
All software purchases must be vetted by IT Security before invoice submission.
Standard laptop and monitor upgrades allowed every 3 years per full-time employee.
Gifts from vendors exceeding $100 must be declared or declined per anti-bribery regulations.
Claims exceeding $1000 undergo random audit verification prior to payout. Payout processed within 10 business days.
